fusions.name: Slipped Edge
fusions.desc: Fires a narrow arrow that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and makes it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. It has 30% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Gutting Cut
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 5 tiles away for a point-blank strike with the bow's bladed limb that deals 13 damage and makes it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Edge Unsheathed
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Opened Veins
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
